enabled.Name: Enable Nameplate Auto-Fit
enabled.Hint: Automatically shrink, wrap, or truncate token nameplates so they never exceed the width of their token.

minFontSize.Name: Minimum Font Size
minFontSize.Hint: The smallest font size nameplates may shrink to before wrapping or truncating instead.

fontShrinkStep.Name: Font Shrink Step
fontShrinkStep.Hint: How many pixels to reduce the nameplate font size by on each shrink attempt.

colorByDisposition.Name: Color Nameplate by Disposition
colorByDisposition.Hint: Color nameplate text using the token's disposition color (hostile, neutral, friendly, or secret).

maxLines.Name: Maximum Nameplate Lines
maxLines.Hint: The maximum number of lines a wrapped nameplate may span before the last line is truncated with an ellipsis.

tooltipAnchor.Name: Elevation Tooltip Position
tooltipAnchor.Hint: Where the elevation tooltip appears relative to the token. "Default" leaves Foundry's own placement untouched.

tooltipOffsetX.Name: Elevation Tooltip Offset X
tooltipOffsetX.Hint: Fine-tune the elevation tooltip's horizontal position, in pixels, from its selected anchor (or from Foundry's default placement).

tooltipOffsetY.Name: Elevation Tooltip Offset Y
tooltipOffsetY.Hint: Fine-tune the elevation tooltip's vertical position, in pixels, from its selected anchor (or from Foundry's default placement).

fadeUnpreparedSpells.Name: Fade Unprepared Spells
fadeUnpreparedSpells.Hint: On a D&D 5e character sheet, dim spells that require preparation but aren't currently prepared. Cantrips, always-prepared, and at-will spells are never dimmed.

unpreparedSpellOpacity.Name: Unprepared Spell Opacity
unpreparedSpellOpacity.Hint: How transparent unprepared spells become (1 = fully opaque/no fade, lower values fade more).

chatNotificationSoundEnabled.Name: Play Sound on Incoming Chat Messages
chatNotificationSoundEnabled.Hint: Play a sound whenever a chat message arrives that wasn't sent by you.

chatNotificationSoundPath.Name: Notification Sound
chatNotificationSoundPath.Hint: The sound file to play for incoming chat messages.

nameplate.Name: Nameplate Settings
nameplate.Label: Nameplate Settings
nameplate.Hint: Configure nameplate auto-fit sizing, wrapping, and disposition coloring.

tooltip.Name: Elevation Tooltip Settings
tooltip.Label: Elevation Tooltip Settings
tooltip.Hint: Configure the elevation tooltip's scale and position.

spellFade.Name: Spell Fade Settings
spellFade.Label: Spell Fade Settings
spellFade.Hint: Configure fading of unprepared spells on D&D 5e character sheets.

DisableAutoFit.Name: Disable Nameplate Auto-Fit
DisableAutoFit.Hint: Prevent this token's nameplate from being automatically shrunk, wrapped, or truncated to fit its width.
